app.name: Glifora
app.tagline: Learn languages by talking with the villagers.
lang.label: Interface language
nav.label: Main navigation
home.title: The village
home.text: The village is still being built. Soon you will be able to walk around it.
welcome.title: Welcome to Glifora
welcome.text: Here you learn languages by talking with the villagers. Coming soon: choosing your language and nickname.
place.title: Place
place.name: Place: {id}
profile.title: Your profile
profile.text: Coming soon: nickname, avatar and languages.
settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Coming soon: reduce motion, sounds and text size.
about.title: About Glifora
about.text: A free, open source game for learning languages by talking. Your progress stays on this device only.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.text: There is nothing at this address.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: Try again. If the problem continues, reload the page.
storage_error.title: Could not open the data on this device
storage_error.text: The browser blocked local storage. This happens in private windows or when storage is turned off. Allow storage for this site and try again.
data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything stays on this device only. Export a file to keep your progress or take it to another device.
data.import.hint: Whatever is newer in the file wins; the rest stays as it is. Importing the same file again changes nothing.

data.import.done.one: Import finished: {n} new or updated item.
data.import.done.other: Import finished: {n} new or updated items.

data.import.nothing: Nothing new in the file: your data was already up to date.
data.import.skipped: Part of the file comes from a newer version of Glifora and was skipped. Update the app to use it.
data.error.heading: Could not import
data.error.too_large: The file is larger than {mb} MB, which is the limit.
data.error.not_json: The file is not valid JSON. Pick a file exported by Glifora.
data.error.wrong_format: This file does not look like it was exported by Glifora.
data.error.too_new: This file is from a newer version of Glifora (format {file}; this app understands up to format {app}). Update the app and try again.
data.error.invalid: The file has problems and nothing was imported. If you need help, copy the details below.
data.error.storage: Could not save to this device.
data.error.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text above and copy it.
data.wipe.heading: Erase everything
data.wipe.hint: Removes the profile, avatar, preferences and chosen language from this device.
data.wipe.button: Erase the data on this device
data.wipe.confirm_text: The profile, avatar, preferences and chosen language will be erased from here, with no way back. If you want to keep your progress, export it first.
